title: Scrum Master
description:
Role & responsibilities: Primary objective: Improve delivery flow, team effectiveness and transparency across DocTutorials product and AI engineering teams. 1. Agile Team Facilitation Facilitate planning, daily coordination, reviews, retrospectives and backlog-refinement readiness. Coach teams on ownership, realistic commitments, collaboration and continuous improvement. Protect teams from avoidable disruption while ensuring business priorities remain visible. Help Product Owners and managers maintain clear goals, dependencies and decisions. 2. Delivery Flow and Governance Track sprint predictability, flow, blockers, dependency ageing, carryover and improvement actions. Escalate material risks early with impact, owner and recovery action. Use metrics to improve the system rather than rank individuals. Coordinate cross-team delivery while keeping accountability with the appropriate owners. 3. AI Project Facilitation Understand the discovery, data, experimentation, evaluation and production stages of AI delivery. Help teams plan AI work with uncertainty, learning milestones and measurable exit criteria. Ensure AI risks involving data, evaluation, security, cost and human validation are visible. Use approved AI tools for meeting synthesis, risk analysis and reporting with verification.

Key Skills: Safe Certified,Development Life Cycle,Software development life cycle,Ai Solutions,Tools,SDLC,Certified,Agile methodology
